Emoji data derives from @lambdalisue/github-emoji 1.0.0 (MIT).

Source: https://jsr.io/@lambdalisue/github-emoji/1.0.0/emojis.json

Source SHA-256: 32ec250b02b7afb313d289df6842e6e57d8001396ea34c30597dc6b1b609e8e5

The generated Lua map decodes hexadecimal Unicode sequences from PNG basenames.
Non-Unicode images use false entries so their names remain unchanged while
consuming the same delimiters as upstream.

Sequences reproduce the source basenames exactly; missing joiners are not inferred.
